blockers.detail: harness calls json_object_to_json_string(obj, FLAGS) (1-arg API) and iterates undeclared jobj; serializer flags path unreachable because the target does not compile

rationale.zh: 本次提交修改 JSON_C_TO_STRING_PRETTY 模式下空对象/空数组的序列化，正是 harness 想驱动的路径（它试图以 PRETTY|SPACED 调用序列化）。但从 4902f9cb87 起，in-tree 的 tokener_parse_ex_fuzzer.cc 用两个参数调用只接受一个参数的 json_object_to_json_string()，并遍历未声明的变量 jobj，harness 根本无法编译。变更前后都编译失败，退化早于本次 diff，属于非本次引入的显式 api 退化；维护者在 4186537557 改用 json_object_to_json_string_ext() 并遍历 obj。
rationale.en: This commit changes how empty objects/arrays are serialised under JSON_C_TO_STRING_PRETTY, exactly the path the harness means to drive (it tries to serialise with PRETTY|SPACED). But since 4902f9cb87 the in-tree tokener_parse_ex_fuzzer.cc calls the one-argument json_object_to_json_string() with two arguments and iterates an undeclared jobj, so the harness does not compile. It fails before and after this change; the degradation predates the diff. Pre-existing explicit api degradation, fixed upstream in 4186537557 (json_object_to_json_string_ext(), iterate obj).
